entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.838 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 52521: radius 0.838 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 0.387 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.051) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4976 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 52521: effective temperature 4976 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.026).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,976 K and log g 4.24 (u1 0.659, u2 0.119): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 4.24 from 2024A&A...683A.125P; the 18 published values span log g 4.16 to 4.57, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
